auth.quote: in the HTTP header: Authorization: Bearer <token>
auth.reason: Gateway API uses a Bearer access token; the MTProto user API uses auth_key_id and api_id/api_hash, which fit Other.

self_serve.quote: Go to "API development tools" and fill out the form.
self_serve.reason: Developers obtain api_id immediately via a form at my.telegram.org, free of charge, with no approval step described.

mcp_status.quote: Give your AI agent complete access to your Telegram workspace
mcp_status.reason: telegram-mcp is hosted by a third party (sandikodev), not Telegram, so it is a community MCP server.

verdict.quote: It is 100% open for all developers who wish to create Telegram applications on our platform.
verdict.reason: Open, free, self-serve API access with documented auth; no gating or outreach requirement is stated.
